# Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP Observability Integrations

> Serverless implementation (Spoke) that ships Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP audit, EMS, and FPolicy events to observability vendors, and builds CloudWatch-native monitoring from CloudFormation templates. The "which collection route" decision is made in the Hub (Adoption Playbook — Observability), not here; this repository is where a chosen route is implemented.

## Entry points

- [README](README.md): Repository hub with the task-oriented "Get Started" table.
- [Documentation index (English)](docs/en/README.md): Every document by category, generated from one category map.
- [ドキュメント索引 (Japanese)](docs/ja/README.md): The same index in Japanese, same set of documents.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Conventions, commands, boundaries, and output standards for coding agents.

## Monitoring design hub

- [Monitoring design](docs/en/monitoring-design.md): In-repo implementation index for CloudWatch-native monitoring of FSx for ONTAP; the collection-route choice is deferred to the Hub.

## CloudWatch templates

- [Performance and capacity dashboard](shared/templates/fsxn-monitoring-dashboard.yaml): CloudFormation dashboard for IOPS, throughput, network, and capacity, with capacity and throughput-utilization alarms.
- [Per-qtree quota monitor](shared/templates/qtree-quota-monitor.yaml): Lambda polls the ONTAP REST API with pagination (up to 10,000 records per SVM), publishes per-qtree quota custom metrics plus an SVM-level maximum that the threshold alarm reads, and supports optional TLS verification (unit-tested against mocked ONTAP responses; on 2026-10-06 one live poll on a first-generation file system published all series and the alarm evaluated it to OK before the run stopped on an ONTAP HTTP 401; the alarm's ALARM path is not yet verified) — see the alarm, coverage, and security notes in monitoring-design.md.
- [Log-based alarm](shared/templates/cloudwatch-log-alarm.yaml): Alarms directly from CloudWatch Logs content using the AWS::CloudWatch::LogAlarm resource.

## Terraform modules

- [Monitoring dashboard module (Terraform)](terraform/fsxn-monitoring-dashboard/README.md): Terraform equivalent of the dashboard template with the capacity and throughput-utilization alarms plus opt-in CPU, disk, and per-volume alarms; offline-verified with a mock provider, and applied once to a first-generation, single-HA-pair file system (2026-10-05).

## Forwarding routes

- [Audit log setup](docs/en/ontap-audit-setup.md): Enabling FSx for ONTAP file-access audit logging and the source paths it writes.
- [EMS detection capabilities](docs/en/ems-detection-capabilities.md): The EMS event catalog and how EMS webhook events are forwarded.
- [FPolicy operational guide](docs/en/fpolicy-operational-guide.md): Running the FPolicy server and forwarding real-time file-operation events.

## Verification results

- [CloudWatch monitoring verification](docs/en/verification-results-cloudwatch-monitoring.md): 2026-10-05 live run of the dashboard template and the Terraform module, and 2026-10-06 qtree quota monitor run (stopped after one successful poll), both on a first-generation, single-HA-pair file system; alarm transitions, findings, and what remains unverified (qtree ALARM path, second generation, multi-HA-pair, SNS delivery).
- [FPolicy, S3 Access Points, and session verification](docs/en/verification-results-fpolicy-s3ap-and-session.md): E2E results for FPolicy forwarding, FSx for ONTAP S3 Access Points, and session handling.
- [EMS and FPolicy verification](docs/en/verification-results-ems-fpolicy.md): E2E results for the EMS webhook and FPolicy event paths.
- [Datadog verification](docs/en/verification-results-datadog.md): E2E delivery results for the Datadog integration.
- [Splunk verification](docs/en/verification-results-splunk.md): E2E delivery results for the Splunk integration.
- [Grafana verification](docs/en/verification-results-grafana.md): E2E delivery results for the Grafana integration.
- [New Relic verification](docs/en/verification-results-new-relic.md): E2E delivery results for the New Relic integration.
- [Elastic verification](docs/en/verification-results-elastic.md): E2E delivery results for the Elastic integration.
- [Dynatrace verification](docs/en/verification-results-dynatrace.md): E2E delivery results for the Dynatrace integration.
- [Sumo Logic verification](docs/en/verification-results-sumo-logic.md): E2E delivery results for the Sumo Logic integration.
- [Honeycomb verification](docs/en/verification-results-honeycomb.md): E2E delivery results for the Honeycomb integration.
- [OpenTelemetry Collector verification](docs/en/verification-results-otel-collector.md): E2E delivery results for the OTel Collector path.
